title: Sort each scenario into AP, NOT AP, or recognise the formula to apply
instructions: Drag each card into the bin that best describes the situation. Watch for the keyword 'difference': constant difference ⇒ AP. For AP situations, decide whether the question wants a particular term (use aₙ) or a partial sum (use Sₙ).

bins.name: AP — apply nth term aₙ
bins.description: Constant common difference and the question asks for one specific term.

bins.name: AP — apply sum Sₙ
bins.description: Constant common difference and the question asks for the total over a stretch of terms.

bins.name: NOT an AP
bins.description: Consecutive differences are not all equal.

bins.name: AM / Inserting means
bins.description: Question is about the arithmetic mean of two numbers or inserting means between them.

items.name: Find the 25th term of 5, 8, 11, 14, …
items.explanation: Constant d = 3; one specific term requested.

items.name: Which term of 3, 7, 11, 15, … equals 99?
items.explanation: Reverse aₙ formula to solve for n.

items.name: a₄ = 14 and a₁₀ = 38; find the AP.
items.explanation: Use two-term recovery to find (a, d).

items.name: Find the sum of the first 20 terms of 5, 8, 11, …
Compute 2 + 4 + 6 + … + 100
items.explanation: Last term given; use Sₙ = n/2 · (a + l).

items.name: Total of 12 monthly instalments — first 500, each next −25
Place A between a and b so that a, A, b is an AP
items.explanation: A is the AM of a and b.
